name: halade-high-school-portal
description: School Management System frontend: role-based dashboards for administrators, teachers, and students.

scripts.predev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { $c.OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; exit 0"
